name.local: JICベンチャー・グロース・インベストメンツ株式会社

aum.raw: 約3,600億円 (VGF1 + VGF2 + OPF1 合計)

size.raw: Approximately 40 billion yen (ファンド規模：400億円)

strategy.thesis: Government-backed growth and later-stage investor under Japan Investment Corporation (JIC). VGF1 backs potential-unicorn startups with growth/later-stage capital before IPO; VGF2 targets Series B and later expansion/growth/later-stage startups plus early-stage deep tech and life science; OPF1 invests in middle-to-late stage startups expected to IPO and provides aftermarket growth capital to post-IPO startups.

application.how_to_apply: Outreach via JIC VGI website; institutional growth/late-stage process.

summary.en: JIC Venture Growth Investments (JIC VGI) is the venture/growth investment arm under the government-affiliated Japan Investment Corporation (JIC), established July 2020. It runs three funds: Venture Growth Fund 1 (~¥120B, 2020) for growth/later-stage pre-IPO support of potential unicorns, Venture Growth Fund 2 (¥200B, 2022) for Series B and later expansion/growth plus early-stage deep tech and life science, and the JICVGI Opportunity Fund 1 (~¥40B, 2023) for direct-secondary middle/late-stage and post-IPO aftermarket growth capital. Backed IPOs include AnyMind Group and Monstarlab.
summary.local: JICベンチャー・グロース・インベストメンツ(JIC VGI)は、官民ファンドである産業革新投資機構(JIC)傘下のベンチャー・グロース投資会社で2020年7月設立。1号ファンド(VGF1、約1,200億円・2020年)はユニコーン候補のグロース/レイターステージのIPO前支援、2号ファンド(VGF2、2,000億円・2022年)はシリーズB以降のエキスパンション/グロース及びディープテック・ライフサイエンスのアーリー以降、オポチュニティファンド1号(OPF1、400億円・2023年)はミドル/レイターのダイレクトセカンダリーと上場後の成長資金を担う。AnyMind Groupやモンスターラボ等のIPOを支援。

name.local: グロービス・キャピタル・パートナーズ株式会社

aka: グロービス・キャピタル

check_size.raw: Up to ¥10 billion per company (Fund VII max)

strategy.thesis: Japan's first full-scale hands-on independent VC (since 1996). 'First to last' policy: leads rounds from early through growth/later stage (including MBO) and supports companies to become unicorns/decacorns and globalize, leveraging the GLOBIS Group network.

application.how_to_apply: Pitch via GCP website; leads early-to-growth rounds in Japan-rooted startups.

summary.en: Globis Capital Partners (GCP), founded in 1996, is one of Japan's largest and oldest independent hands-on VCs, with cumulative AUM exceeding US$1.8 billion (~¥180B). Its largest fund, GLOBIS Fund VII, final-closed at ¥72.7 billion in 2022 with up to ¥10B investable per company, and it opened a San Francisco office to support portfolio globalization. Under its 'first to last' policy it leads rounds from early through growth/later stage. Notable winners include Mercari, GREE and SmartNews.
summary.local: グロービス・キャピタル・パートナーズ(GCP)は1996年設立、日本最大級かつ最古参の独立系ハンズオンVCの一つで、累計運用額は18億米ドル超(約180億円規模を積み上げ、累計約1,800億円)。最大の7号ファンドは2022年に727億円でファイナルクローズし、1社あたり最大100億円を投資、サンフランシスコ拠点も開設。「first to last」方針でアーリーからグロース/レイターまでリード投資。メルカリ、GREE、SmartNews等を輩出。

strategy.thesis: Growth-stage VC bridging US/European startups with Japanese corporations and government LPs. US investments concentrate on later-stage rounds (Series B and beyond) in B2B SaaS/DX; helps startups scale into Japan and Japanese companies globalize.

summary.en: WiL (World Innovation Lab) is a US-Japan growth-stage VC founded in 2013 by Gen Isayama (ex-DCM) and Masataka Matsumoto, with offices in Palo Alto and Tokyo. In June 2022 it raised over $1 billion in additional capital — including its third growth fund, WiL Ventures III, and Strategic Partners funds — taking total commitments across all funds above $1.9 billion. Its US investing concentrates on later-stage (Series B+) B2B SaaS. Portfolio includes 15 unicorns; public exits include Mercari, Asana, Wise, Raksul and Auth0 (acquired by Okta).
summary.local: WiL(ワールド・イノベーション・ラボ)は2013年に伊佐山元氏(元DCM)と松本真尚氏が設立した日米のグロースステージVCで、パロアルトと東京に拠点。2022年6月に3号グロースファンド「WiL Ventures III」やStrategic Partnersを含め10億ドル超を追加調達し、全ファンド累計コミットメントは19億ドル超。米国投資はシリーズB以降のレイターステージB2B SaaSが中心。15社のユニコーンを輩出し、メルカリ、Asana、Wise、ラクスル、Auth0(Oktaが買収)等が上場・M&A。

summary.en: Eight Roads Ventures Japan is the Tokyo-based growth-stage venture arm of Fidelity (FIL), investing in Japan since 2012. Its third fund (Fund III), established November 2022, is ¥28 billion (280億円), bringing cumulative AUM across its three funds to about ¥75 billion. It targets growth-stage startups in enterprise tech, fintech and biotech, expanding into energy, AI, robotics, food tech and precision medicine.

summary.en: IF Growth is a dedicated growth-capital fund launched by Incubate Fund (one of Japan's leading seed VCs), which completed first close in May 2025 with a planned total of ¥30 billion (総額300億円). It targets non-listed growth-stage / pre-IPO Japanese startups to address the 'small IPO' problem, with focus on Deep Tech, Creative Industry and Business Solution. It is backed by the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's public-private Impact Growth Fund and is led by GP Masashi Ihara (ex-SMBC Nikko).
summary.local: 「IF Growth」はシード期に強いインキュベイトファンドがグロースキャピタルに特化して立ち上げたファンドで、2025年5月にファーストクローズ、ファンド総額300億円を予定。非上場グロース市場/IPO前の国内スタートアップを対象に「スモールIPO問題」の解決を狙い、ディープテック・クリエイティブ・ビジネスソリューションに注力。東京都の官民連携インパクトグロースファンドの出資を受け、元SMBC日興証券の井原昌史氏が専任GPを務める。

summary.en: Minerva Growth Partners is a Japan-based growth-equity / crossover fund investing in later-stage venture (minority) and buyout/PIPE deals in software, internet and SaaS across Japan and Asia. Core check size is ¥1–3 billion per deal (smaller earlier-stage tickets from a few hundred million yen). It invests once PMF and unit economics are confirmed and holds through IPO and beyond (crossover, via Pleiad Investment Advisors). It had invested in 8 companies as of February 2025; leadership includes ex-Morgan Stanley and ex-Mercari CFO operators.

summary.en: Growth Capital Inc. (グロース・キャピタル) is a Tokyo firm founded in April 2019 by Masato Minei that provides growth-capital 'offensive finance' and post-raise growth-strategy execution for listed (post-IPO) Japanese ventures. It has supported 15+ growth-finance cases totalling over ¥180 billion raised (e.g. Aiming ¥21.2B, Kudan ¥30.1B, Cybersecurity Cloud ¥21.4B) and supports 30+ listed ventures via IR services. Its registered capital is ¥30 million; it operates as an advisory/finance specialist rather than a pooled fund.

summary.en: Keyrock Capital Management is a Hong Kong-based crossover investment firm (founded 2018) focused on emerging-growth Asia-Pacific companies, with a particular emphasis on Japan. Led by Managing Partner Jonathan Shih (ex-Lehman, McKinsey, Tybourne), it invests at growth and pre-IPO stages and also holds public-market positions (e.g. Money Forward), bridging private and public markets. Notable Japanese investments include Timee, LayerX, Nealle and Zeroboard. Included here for its active growth/late-stage role in Japan despite its Hong Kong domicile.

summary.en: RJ Value Plus 1 is a later-stage / pre-IPO venture investment fund jointly established on 15 November 2024 by Resona Bank and J-Growth (a subsidiary of the J-Will Group). It targets domestic later-stage startups from the late stage through and beyond IPO, providing growth capital and operational support (capital-efficiency proposals, mid-term planning, governance, and post-listing IR) to help fill the later-stage funding gap in Japan's venture market. The fund size is not publicly disclosed.
summary.local: RJバリューPlus1号は、りそな銀行とジェイ・ウィル・グループ傘下のジェイ・グロースが2024年11月15日に共同組成した、レイターステージ/IPO前のベンチャー投資ファンド。レイターステージからIPO後に該当する国内スタートアップを対象に、成長資金に加えて資本効率改善提案・中期経営計画・ガバナンス・上場後IR支援を提供し、日本のレイターステージ資金ギャップを埋める。ファンド規模は非開示。
